definition: An index opened at an address that names no record shows its list and no record beside it: nothing is chosen for the reader. Choose one from the list and it opens here, and the address then names it.
basis: Our wording of the rule that a bare address names no record, which the workbench already keeps for the Styles index and the pack index. docs/workbench.md: "each surface fell back to its own hard-coded record.", "the Styles index, an outline that never shows a record" and "A bare `#/proportions` is the pack index and draws no"
